name: Plant Nerd | Pink Perfume
description: This is a strain we pheno hunted in early 2025. The flower has a very perfumey, floral nose that we’ve never experienced before this strain. The flower has strong bag appeal with larger dark fuchsia/pink buds that are covered in trichomes. We’re growing Pink Perfume because it’s fire weed but in an all around unique way.
